description: Lets a school on Knola send its course emails and newsletters from its own subdomain (for example mail.school.com) through Amazon SES: three Easy DKIM CNAMEs, a custom MAIL FROM on bounce.<host> (MX + SPF), and a DMARC policy on the subdomain only. Knola always applies it with a host (the school's sending subdomain), never to the root of the domain, so the school's website and inbox records are untouched.
variableDescription: %dkimToken1%, %dkimToken2%, %dkimToken3%: the three Amazon SES Easy DKIM tokens issued for this identity; %region%: the Amazon SES region the identity lives in, for example eu-west-2
